statements.quote: During the second quarter, the Company purchased a 128-GPU cluster from NVIDIA, financed by a leading OEM.
statements.notes: The release reports a GPU purchase for the HPC/AI project but gives no dollar amount. It was OEM-financed, so it may not appear as cash capex. The sentence names no year, so code applies the filing year.

statements.quote: To support this project, the Company has upgraded the internet interconnection at the Lake Mariner Facility to meet the bandwidth requirements of AI, designed a closed- loop liquid cooling system, and ensured power supply redundancy for 100% reliability.
statements.notes: This describes AI-related infrastructure work with no amount. 'Designed' a cooling system may not be spend yet. The '100%' refers to reliability and is not a share of spend.

statements.quote: Reflects TeraWulf’s 30% equity contribution for construction of CB-1, a liquid-cooled, redundant, and high- power density 20 MW (gross) HPC/AI infrastructure expected to be substantially complete by year-end.
statements.notes: This is a slide footnote, not a full sentence with a subject. The 30% is TeraWulf's equity stake in the CB-1 joint venture, not AI's share of capex, so it is recorded as qualitative. The dollar figure appears only in the chart graphics and is not stated in the text. 'By year-end' is not a named year.
